expectedIssues: Middle card in the carousel is not aligned with the other cards
reportedIssues: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the cards are not aligned on a common baseline: the 'Green Bowl Poké' image block is shorter and sits higher, 'Smash Bros Burgers' is shifted ~40px lower, so titles and delivery-fee lines appear at three different vertical positions.
The third card ('Trattoria Piccol…', '€1.90 delivery') is hard-clipped at the right edge of the screen with no ellipsis or partial-card peek styling, making it look broken rather than scrollable.
The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza with −20% badge) is cut off by the fixed bottom navigation bar; its name, rating and delivery info are not visible, so the list appears to end mid-card.

Inconsistent image treatment: the 'Green Bowl Poké' tile has a flat light-gray background with a centered illustration while sibling tiles use dark photographic imagery, suggesting a failed image load or fallback placeholder.
The favorite (heart) buttons differ between the two 'Popular right now' cards: the first is an unfilled outline with no background, the second sits on a dark filled circle.
The time badges ('15–25 min', '20–30 min') sit at different vertical offsets within their cards and one overlaps the card's bottom edge, breaking visual rhythm.
The category chip row is clipped mid-chip at the right edge with no fade or partial-chip affordance, so users may not realize more filters exist.
